title: THE MASTER AND MARGARITA: 50th-Anniversary Edition (Penguin Classics Deluxe Edition)
author: Mikhail Bulgakov, Christopher Conn Askew, Boris Fishman, Richard Pevear, and Larissa Volokhonsky

highlights.text: The thought that there is no greater misfortune in the world than the loss of reason?
One needed only to raise one’s head from the lamp to the sky to understand that the night was irretrievably lost.
